title: Published index
description: The manifest of a published/ folder (Reflect framework plan, step 6): every file that went out through the presentation gate, with its sha256, the presentation record that passed the gate, its channel, when the person approved it, and who approved it (always the person). Reflect writes it at published/index.json. A site that consumes the folder reads it; the site's repository keeps it at content/reflect/index.json unless the person names another folder. packages/core/src/published.ts writes and checks it.

entries.description: One entry per file, sorted by path. index.json itself is not listed.

sha256.description: sha256 of the file's bytes, in hex

presentation.description: The id of the presentation record that passed the gate

channel.description: The presentation policy channel it went out on

approved_by.description: Only the person approves; an agent may draft and check
